blocks.title: CIO Toolkit executive briefing
blocks.note: Demonstration pack. Every number and source in this draft is illustrative. No live enterprise data or AI service is connected.

sections.heading: Executive assessment
paragraphs: Release R-214 in week 9 affected operations, cost, delivery and security. MTTR peaked at {{K17:mttr:at(8)}} and is back to {{K17:mttr:last}}. Cloud cost rose {{K07:spikeW9}} ({{K07:spikeAmt}}) in week 9 and is still {{K07:vsW8}} above week 8.
Year-to-date spend is {{K06:budgetYtd}} against budget ({{K06:monthlyActual:sum}} against {{K06:monthlyBudget:sum}}).

sections.heading: Operations and service
paragraphs: Payments availability is {{K16:paymentsAvailability}} against a {{K16:target}} target, and {{K16:servicesMeetingSla}} critical services meet it. P1 and P2 incidents in week 12: {{K17:incidents:last}}.

sections.heading: Value and financial discipline
paragraphs: Renewals due in the next 6 to 12 months: {{K09:renewals}}. The Observability platform (notice by 15 Nov 2026) and ERP licences (notice by 20 Dec 2026) both carry price uplifts of 7% or more. Cloud waste is {{K07:wasteShare}} of spend and needs FinOps validation before action.

sections.heading: Security and delivery
paragraphs: {{K20:criticalOpen}} critical vulnerabilities are open and {{K20:patchedInSla}} were patched within SLA against a {{K20:patchTarget}} target. {{K24:overdue}} audit findings are overdue ({{K24:high}} high, {{K24:medium}} medium).
{{K14:flagged}} of {{K14:total}} projects are reported Green but show risk signals.

sections.heading: AI
paragraphs: LLM spend reached {{K35:llmSpendWeekly:last}} last week. {{K32:measuredBenefit}} live use cases have a measured benefit.

sections.heading: Trust and open issues
paragraphs: All figures are illustrative and have not come from connected sources. Forecasts are indicative. Approval: pending CIO and Finance review.
